label: King of the Franks
notes: Rex Francorum; supreme monarch when the realm was united.

label: King of Neustria
notes: Sub-king in the western Frankish partition (around Soissons/Paris).

label: King of Austrasia
notes: Sub-king in the eastern Frankish partition (around Metz).

label: King of Burgundy
notes: Sub-king in the southeastern Frankish partition (around Lyon).

label: Mayor of the Palace
notes: Major domus; chief officer who often wielded effective power in late Merovingian period.
